title: Repeat-Level Late Fees: Crediting Basis on the Crestline Credit Card
content:
For a Northgate late-fee courtesy credit on the Crestline Credit Card, the credit basis depends on the level the fee was charged at: when the fee was charged at the repeat amount (the product's repeat late fee) and no late fee besides it was posted fewer than 3 months before today, the part of the fee above the first-violation amount (the product's first late fee) is credited outright and the share of the fee that the courtesy credit returns is applied to the first-violation amount; when the fee was charged at the repeat amount and another late fee was posted fewer than 3 months before today, nothing is credited outright and the share is applied to the first-violation amount only; otherwise nothing is credited outright and the share is applied to the whole fee.

The repeat amount is 41 USD and the first-violation amount is 30 USD on every product (Crestline Auto Care Card Starter, Crestline Auto Care Card, Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred, Crestline Auto Care Mastercard, Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred and Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard), so the part above it is 11 USD.

## Basis table

| Fee charged at | Another late fee posted fewer than 3 months before today | Credited outright | Share applied to |
|---|---|---|---|
| the repeat amount, 41 USD | no | the part above 30 USD, 11 USD | 30 USD |
| the repeat amount, 41 USD | yes | nothing | 30 USD only |
| any other amount (the first amount, or a fee capped below either) | any | nothing | the whole fee |

The credit is the part credited outright plus the share of the amount the share is applied to.

## Cases (hypothetical share of 0.6)

- Fee of 41 USD, no other late fee in the last 3 months: 11 USD outright plus 0.6 of 30 USD (18 USD), 29 USD in all.
- Fee of 41 USD, another late fee 2 months ago: 0.6 of 30 USD, 18 USD.
- Fee of 25 USD (capped at a 25 USD minimum): 0.6 of 25 USD, 15 USD.
